_about: Supplement Facts panels transcribed to text from the panel captures in captures/. One entry per scored product, keyed by the product name in pilot-scores.csv. Wording, amounts and %DV are copied as printed; symbols (TM, (R)) are kept where legible. 'dv' is the %DV column as printed, with the panel's footnote marker resolved to 'not established' where the panel says so. Transcribed 2026-11-19. Where the capture a score was read from is cropped, the panel was re-captured from the live listing on 2026-11-19 and the entry's capture_note says so; a transcription error is a site error, report it through the corrections process on about.html.
